messages:
alex: Quick sync — start onboarding for aurora-8b v0.9 (fp16 base). Need intake checklist, quant plan, model-catalog entry, docs, and announcement coord. @maria @jamal @lee @sophia

maria: Uploaded initial evals to the bucket. High-level: slightly worse on summarization vs our 7B baseline (~1.8% abs drop on S-Bench), but p50 token latency is ~22% better. Int8 PTQ looks promising for perf.

jamal: Can you drop raw perf numbers (batch, seq len, HW) and the quant config used?

maria: Perf snapshot: batch=8, seq=512, hw=A100-40. fp16 p50 token latency=78ms, tokens/sec=1200 under continuous batching. PTQ int8 (per-channel symmetric + clip 0.01) p50=45ms, tokens/sec=2100. End-to-end generation time measured on 512 tokens. Logs: gs://redwood-evals/aurora-8b/174/

lee: Noted quality regressions on codegen and multi-paragraph summarization. Suggest we gate canary until we run prompt-normalization eval and regen tests. Also check long-context (>1024) behavior.

jamal: For quant experiments I'll run two profiles: int8-fast (aggressive clipping, lower precision for matmuls) and int8-safe (per-channel, larger clip threshold). If regressions persist, we try QAT. Will run 2 seeds each.

alex: Proposed rollout playbook: 1) intake PR with README + eval results + perf report 2) model-catalog draft (tags, recommended uses, constraints) 3) run quant matrix (fast/safe) 4) canary in Dedicated (5% traffic) + smoke tests 5) docs + release note + public announcement. Who owns the canary?

lee: I'll own canary on Dedicated pool C-2. Need infra ticket to reserve capacity and a rollout window. Prefer Thu morning UTC.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Created INF-4827 for aurora-8b canary reservation. Window: Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC. Canary config: 5% traffic, fallback to 7b-matched if anomaly > 3x error rate.

eval-bot: eval-bot: kicked off job aurora-8b/summary-suite:v1 -> job ev-9912 (running). Will post results to the intake PR when done.

maria: Extra note: observed hallucination spike on long-context tests (seq > 1024) — roughly 4% F1 drop. Might be positional encoding/truncation mismatch vs training.

jamal: Did training use rotary embeddings or absolute? If rotary, we should check rotary base and offset handling in our loader. Also run a small inference test with patched pos-enc to confirm.

maria: Quick config snippet from model card: ```
model_arch: transformer
params: 8_000_000_000
positional_encoding: rotary
rotary_base: 10000
fp_precision: fp16
```

lee: Good catch. If it's a loader mismatch we'll need a tiny conversion step in the serving pipeline; low-risk but blocks canary until fixed.

sophia: I'll draft the model-catalog entry and internal docs. Proposed catalog tags: ["transformer","8B","fp16","quantizable"]. Recommended_uses: chat, short summarization. Not recommended: high-precision codegen, long-context summarization (until fixed).

alex: For the announcement plan: internal note + release checklist + 1-pager for sales (latency/cost uplift numbers) -> target internal share Fri EOD, public docs next Tue.

jamal: Actionable quant plan: run numeric stability tests (outlier detection), run per-channel symmetric PTQ with clip 0.01 and 0.001, then int8-safe. If regression > 2% on S-Bench, escalate to QAT experiments.

maria: I'll attach the full eval matrix to the intake PR and include per-example diffs for the top 200 regression cases.

alex: Action items: alex -> open intake PR by EOD today; maria -> finish quant runs + upload logs by tomorrow 12:00 UTC; jamal -> run qmatrix and post configs; lee -> create canary infra (INF-4827 exists) and run smoke tests; sophia -> catalog + docs draft by Fri. :thumbsup:

alex: Any blockers?

maria: One blocker: we need the training tokenizer spec (vocab merges/version). If someone from model-ops can attach it to the PR that unblocks regen tests.

lee: I'll ping model-ops and add a follow-up.

sophia: Confirming deadlines. I'll sync with marketing for the external release wording.

jamal: I'll start the int8-fast run now and post logs to gs://redwood-quant/aurora-8b/

alex: Thanks everyone. We’ll reconvene after eval-bot posts results.

maria: ack :eyes:

lee: ack :+1:
